title: Lovely 1BR/BA!! Close to Downtown Nashville
description:
The Best Western Plus Executive Residency Nashville is conveniently located just four miles from Downtown Nashville with easy access to I-65 and I-24. Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

The space
2 Queen Beds
390 sq feet

Internet - Free WiFi

Entertainment - 50-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels

Food & Drink - Refrigerator, microwave, coffee/tea maker, and freezer

Sleep - Blackout drapes/curtains and bed sheets

Bathroom - Private bathroom, shower/tub combination, free toiletries, and a hair dryer

Practical - Iron/ironing board, laptop workspace, and phone

Comfort - Air conditioning and daily housekeeping

Other things to note
The name on the reservation will need to be name of the individual checking in at the front desk.

Refundable Deposit: $50  per stay. Major debit, credit card, or cash accepted at check in. Card must match name on reservation

Seasonal Pool hours: May-August. Subject to change
